answer: Make every new seat require a bonded surety, a third party who posts collateral that is slashed if that agent defrauds. Backing one honest agent is cheap, like framing with sound timber; but underwriting a whole nebula of lockstep clones means perfectly correlated default, so actuarial pricing turns the premium convex, 100 fakes cost about 100x a single bond rather than one flat fee. That staked capital is a marble footing no clone can counterfeit, making extra identities prohibitively expensive instead of free.
